Theme 035 · Light, optics & texture

Point Cloud

Thousands of soft particles on a deep void, each one an event from your product. The cloud keeps morphing between meaningful forms (a swarm of dashboards, the pulse line, a dot-stacked chart) and every morph lands on a readable data shape. Healthy points are cool teal dust; the anomaly is three coral embers that refuse to settle.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Particle field — 10–20k soft points (WebGL points or canvas 2D, additive blend); each point is one event.
  • Target shapes — position buffers sampled from SVG/text: dashboard outlines, the pulse line, a dot-stacked chart, a ring.
  • Coral embers — outlier points with a glow and a curved trail that refuse to settle; the anomaly.
  • Expected-level ghosts — dashed coral rings where points should be; makes "−18%" visible as absence.
  • Pinned labels — mono HUD text and a dashed leader line from an ember to its decision card.
  • Event counter — "2,418 events/sec" readout that sells the scale of what's being watched.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Shape morph — uProgress 0→1 between position buffers, per-particle delay by index, power3.inOut 1.6 s; starts on the 0:08 drop and settles on beat 4.
  • Curl drift — seeded noise offset keeps the idle cloud breathing; amplitude pumps +20 % on each kick at 120 BPM.
  • Ember isolation — flagged points detach upward and the camera pushes in (expo.out 0.8 s) landing on the snare.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Showing every event at once makes "watching everything" tangible, and three misbehaving points out of thousands is an instantly readable story. Risk: "AI dust" is a cliché; every morph must land on a real, readable data shape.

Adapt to your product: Map one particle to one unit of your product (a request, an order, a user session) and morph the cloud into your own chart; the embers become whatever your product flags.
